name: Registry Modifications
description: Registry value changes from Security auditing (4657), object-access events, and Sysmon registry create/delete, value set and rename (12/13/14). The Security object-access events (4656, 4658-4660, 4663, 4670) cover files and other objects as well as registry keys: check their Object Type. Sysmon registry events can number in the millions.
author: EventHawk (Microsoft documentation, SANS, Sigma)

event_descriptions.4659: Handle to an object requested with intent to delete
event_descriptions.4663: Attempt made to access an object
event_descriptions.12: Sysmon: registry key or value created or deleted
event_descriptions.14: Sysmon: registry key or value renamed
